N/R - Ansf.

Dear Sir,

As an avid smoker for 60 years, and having a family which grows tobacco in Bristol, VA farms, I ask you to not spend your millions of dollars on people that say cigar smoke causes cancer.

These people are bilking you out of all your billion dollars, which they do not deserve.

Saw them there taking you.

Sorry to help.

Dale Barnadi
33 N. Main
Warren
Pennsylvania
